mechanism: The Deployment fraud/fraud-scoring sets .spec.template.spec.containers[scorer].resources.requests.cpu to "512" — 512 whole cores — where "512m" (512 millicores) was intended, and the cluster's single node offers only 6 allocatable CPUs. The scheduler cannot fit the pod on any node, so the Deployment's replica is rejected at scheduling with "Insufficient cpu", stays Pending with PodScheduled=False, and the Deployment remains at 0/1 ready.
